$Comment: The panel the progress bars are drawn on: whether it shows at all, where it sits, and how many
bars it stacks at once. The bars themselves are authored one per file under
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudBars/, each naming the value that fills it.
Position is a corner preset (TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, CenterLeft, Center, CenterRight,
BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight) plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins; the
default sits high in the left column, deliberately over the mob inspector card another mod draws
there: the panel is transparent and the two read fine stacked. Move it to clear whatever else your
server puts in that corner. MaxVisible runs from 1 to 4: when more bars are moving than that, the
most recently moved ones are shown.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Default' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-panels.json with only the leaves you want different. Set Enabled to
false there to switch every bar off at once.
